title: clematis koreana var. lutea
intro: Clematis koreana var. lutea, commonly known as Golden Clematis, is a perennial flowering plant that belongs to the Ranunculaceae family. The plant is known for its vibrant yellow flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing stress and anxiety, promoting relaxation, and aiding in the treatment of insomnia. Research on Golden Clematis has identified its therapeutic actions as including sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
